answer: Bind each agent identity to a TPM endorsement key as its kernel of trust. (1) Registration needs attestation that the key lives in a real TPM chip, not a VM. (2) The chain keeps a registry: one key, one identity, duplicates rejected. (3) Key rotation needs fresh attestation plus a 14-day wait. (4) A proven fake burns the key forever. Forging 1,000 agents needs 1,000 TPM chips at $12 each plus $4,000 setup labor: $16,000 and three weeks, for chips that die on first detection. Like a lotus that only blooms from one root in a quiet harbor, identity grows from hardware no copy-paste can fake.
